practical_guide.title: Find a general practitioner

short_summary.text: Ask nearby practices about registration and arrange a record transfer after acceptance.

who_this_is_for.text: Residents settling in Leiden or moving away from their current GP’s area.

when_you_need_it.text: Residents settling in Leiden or moving away from their current GP’s area.

numbered_steps.title: Step 1
numbered_steps.body: Look for practices near your new address and ask whether they can accept you. Capacity and distance can affect acceptance.

numbered_steps.title: Step 2
numbered_steps.body: After the new practice accepts you, tell your previous GP and ask for transfer of your medical record. Ask the new practice which registration information it requires.

numbered_steps.title: Step 3
numbered_steps.body: If you cannot find a practice, ask your health insurer to help or mediate. For visitors or people without a regular GP, use the separate De Limes guidance when urgent care is needed.

warnings.text: Registration availability is not guaranteed. For immediate danger call 112; this guide is about access to care, not diagnosis.

practical_guide.disclaimer: General practical information; the responsible authority or care provider decides your individual case.

practical_guide.title: Medicines and out-of-hours care

short_summary.text: Use routine pharmacy services for planned needs and the regional emergency service for urgent needs.

who_this_is_for.text: Residents and visitors needing medicines when their usual provider is closed.

when_you_need_it.text: Residents and visitors needing medicines when their usual provider is closed.

numbered_steps.title: Step 1
numbered_steps.body: For routine medicines, contact your regular pharmacy during its opening hours. For urgent medicines outside those hours, check the current service pharmacy on SSDR.

numbered_steps.title: Step 2
numbered_steps.body: If a GP problem cannot wait until the next regular consultation, call De Limes first. Its website selects the appropriate service by postcode; do not assume every patient uses the same site.

numbered_steps.title: Step 3
numbered_steps.body: Bring an up-to-date medication list and identification to the service pharmacy, and follow its payment instructions. For a life-threatening situation call 112.

required_documents.text: Current medication overview and valid identification; have BSN available where applicable.

warnings.text: Service pharmacies are for urgent medication. Charges depend on the service and medicines; no personal reimbursement assessment is provided.

practical_guide.disclaimer: General practical information; the responsible authority or care provider decides your individual case.
